title: Text: DET Dave Littlefield ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Anthony: The Tigers had Gerald Laird lined up to manage their Rookie league team in Connecticut, but now they have another manager.  What happened with G $ ?
Question from a reader. I know what happened last spring but that was a year ago

In the best interest of all parties, we decided to go in a different direction with the manager’s position at Connecticut. We thanked Gerald for his time with us, and we have mutually agreed to part ways.
